description.narrative: As part of the global debt relief initiative known as “HIPC,” donors agreed to compensate IDA at each replenishment for the foregone reflows associated with debt relief. HIPC, which is currently at around USD17 billion, was designed to ensure that the poorest countries in the world are able to make reforms while not being overwhelmed by unmanageable or unsustainable debt burdens. Australia as a signatory to the HIPC initiative provided a share of 1.61 per cent of agreed HIPC costs for IDA20.
